description: Source code for the SystemCheck class within the OrangeHRM installer utilities. The class performs various system environment and configuration checks such as PHP version, database compatibility, directory permissions, and extension availability, to ensure the environment meets the requirements for installing or running OrangeHRM.

classes.name: SystemCheck
classes.description: Performs system environment and configuration checks necessary for the installation or operation of OrangeHRM. Checks include PHP version, database support, directory permissions, PHP extensions, and server configurations.

methods.name: isPHPVersionCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP version is within the acceptable range as specified in environment requirements.

methods.name: isMySqlClientCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the MySQL client version is acceptable for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: isMySqlServerCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the MySQL server version meets the required criteria.

methods.name: isInnoDBSupport
methods.description: Verifies if the InnoDB storage engine is supported and enabled in the database.

methods.name: isWebServerCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the current web server matches the supported web server list.

methods.name: isWritableConfigDir
methods.description: Checks if the configuration directory is writable.

methods.name: isWritableCacheDir
methods.description: Checks if the cache directory is writable.

methods.name: isWritableLogDir
methods.description: Checks if the log directory is writable.

methods.name: isWritableCryptoKeyDir
methods.description: Checks if the cryptokeys directory is writable.

methods.name: isMaximumSessionIdle
methods.description: Checks the PHP session maximum idle time setting.

methods.name: isRegisterGlobalsOff
methods.description: Verifies if register_globals PHP setting is turned off.

methods.name: getAllocatedMemoryStatus
methods.description: Checks the currently allocated PHP script memory limit.

methods.name: isCurlEnabled
methods.description: Verifies if cURL extension is enabled.

methods.name: isSimpleXMLEnabled
methods.description: Verifies if SimpleXML extension is enabled.

methods.name: isZipExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Verifies if ZIP extension is enabled.

methods.name: isGdExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Verifies if GD extension is enabled.

methods.name: isIntlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Verifies if Intl extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkPDOExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PDO extension is loaded.

methods.name: checkPDOMySqlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PDO MySQL extension is loaded.

methods.name: isLDAPExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if LDAP extension is enabled.

methods.name: isOpenSSLExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if OpenSSL extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkWritePermission
methods.description: Attempts to write and remove a temporary file to verify directory writability.

methods.name: getSizeInBytes
methods.description: Converts PHP memory size strings (e.g., '128M', '1G') into bytes.

methods.name: isWithinRange
methods.description: Checks if a version is within a specified range and not excluded.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message related to PHP version requirements or exclusions.

methods.name: isExcluded
methods.description: Checks if a version is in an exclusion list.

methods.name: getPhpVersion
methods.description: Returns the current PHP version.

methods.name: getWebServerDetails
methods.description: Returns server software details.

methods.name: getMysqlClientVersion
methods.description: Returns MySQL client version.

methods.name: getMysqlServerVersion
methods.description: Returns MySQL server version.

methods.name: getMySqlHostInfo
methods.description: Returns MySQL connection host info.

methods.name: getOSDetails
methods.description: Returns operating system details.

methods.name: getPDOConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a PDO connection if available.

methods.name: getSystemDetails
methods.description: Returns overall system environment details.

methods.name: getSystemCheckResults
methods.description: Aggregates and returns the results of various system checks in categories.
